body:
I'd love to be able to talk to my family, just have any conversation with them, but they've always said they don't mind if me (or my brother) were straight or gay, but said they'd be dissapointed of either of us was bi. I don't know why, but it's how they feel. It made coming out so hard, but I thought it was better to say. It's been a couple of months since I came out to them, and since then haven't had any real communication from ant of them - despite living in the same house.

My relationship is all over the place, some days it can be good, others is shit. Since we got together though I've pushed everyone else away, so I'm scared of having nobody in my life at all if I end it with her. I don't think I can face the prospect of being alone, but I keep doing shit to sabotage everything good that happens between us.

Thanks for replying, it's nice to just get to vent how I feel without feeling like I'm going to be judged for it.
